segments.he: נַעֲרָה הַמְאוֹרָסָה, אָבִיהָ וּבַעְלָהּ מְפִירִין נְדָרֶיהָ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «a betrothed young woman, her father and her husband» together «nullify her vows.»

segments.he: הֵפֵר הָאָב וְלֹא הֵפֵר הַבַּעַל, הֵפֵר הַבַּעַל וְלֹא הֵפֵר הָאָב — אֵינוֹ מוּפָר. וְאֵין צָרִיךְ לוֹמַר שֶׁקִּיֵּים אֶחָד מֵהֶן.
segments.en: If «the father nullified» her vow «and the husband did not nullify» it, or if «the husband nullified» it «and the father did not nullify» it, then the vow «is not nullified. And needless to say,» it is not nullified «if one of them ratified» the vow.

moves.cueHe: נערה המאורסה, אביה ובעלה מפירין נדריה
moves.summary: father and husband nullify a betrothed young woman's vows
nullification by one alone is ineffective, needless to say if the other ratified

positions.claim: father and betrothed husband together nullify; either alone does not, and all the more so if one ratified
